card.name: Inside the word heavy
card.fires_on: The word heavy and its forms (heavily, heavens, HEAVY) when split into pieces, especially the middle or final piece. Also fires on Heavy after super or in titles like Heavy Water.

modes.label: Split pieces of heavy
modes.description: The middle or ending piece of heavy, heavily or heavens, often in capitals.

modes.label: Heavy after a compound start
modes.description: The whole word Heavy following super or a place name.

card.plain: It lights up on the word heavy, such as heavy sedation or heavy water, when the word is broken into parts.
